description: This file defines the UserListBuilder class for building a listing of user entities in Drupal, including methods for loading users, building headers and rows for display, and handling operations.

classes.name: UserListBuilder
classes.description: A class extending EntityListBuilder to generate a list of user entities with custom headers, rows, and operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing services for date formatting and redirect destination.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of UserListBuilder with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads user entities with specific query conditions and pagination.

methods.name: buildHeader
methods.description: Builds the header array for the user list table.

methods.name: buildRow
methods.description: Builds a table row for a given user entity, including username, status, roles, member duration, and last access.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Defines operations (like edit) available for each user entity, adding redirect destination info.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the user list table, setting a message for empty lists.
